[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”5ff55506-da7d-4dd7-b409-9d62c7203201″ text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0.55)” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_text_color=”#466AA3″ hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”15px” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”55px” header_font_size_last_edited=”off|desktop” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

D&P contractors is an established top service/install and sales company serving Paris TX and Surrounding Northeast Texas Areas. Our valued customers depend on straight answers about equipment from a professional and reliable source. We pride ourselves in not only fitting you with the correct equipment for your current and future needs, but also being there for the maintenance and repair of your equipment. We know that once you make the purchase that is just the beginning of the relationship. In addition to having an extensive inventory we are also able to quickly order and find parts that you may need for older equipment.

 

Our crew is trained and reliable. We are all professionals in the industry with one main purpose – to ensure customer satisfaction. Owner Dan Blount has more than 35 years of experience working on commercial refrigeration and heating systems. We have the tools and knowledge to accurately perform commercial equipment repairs and installations.  We take our work seriously, and we value every one of our clients. Our technicians always strive to offer prompt service, and we only use quality equipment and parts. The work we do requires a great deal of skill, so count on our professionals to handle your project every step of the way.

To learn more about the dedicated professionals who will be serving your needs when you schedule an appointment with us, please enjoy viewing the many informative pages of our website where you will have an opportunity to learn more specific details about the services we deliver, our standards in conduct and dedication to complete customer satisfaction, as well as the values we at D & P hold dear and practice on a daily basis.

 

We look forward to gaining your trust to be the last HVAC company you call.
